notes.title: 🇵🇱 Celebrate Polish Constitution Days With Lumberhill! 🇵🇱
notes.content:
🌿 The spring is here, and May 3rd is getting closer and closer - get ready to dive into the vortex of creativity to celebrate Polish gamedev!

It was the third day of May of the year 1791 when the Polish Constitution was signed. It was a modern constitution seeking to implement wide state reforms, advancing democratization of Poland, and including checks and balances and tripartite separation of powers. It was the first such document in Europe, and the second in the world, following the American one from 1787. To this day, we're celebrating it as one of the peak achievements of the Age of Enlightenment in Poland and the foundations of Polish democracy. 

[hr][/hr]

☀️ While historically, 3 May is a very important holiday, we celebrate it in different ways. We quite often take advantage of the warm sun of May and spring in full bloom, lighting up that grill and gathering for a BBQ ♨️ We can't back this up with any scientific data, but this could be the period when most Polish gamers are finally touching grass!

Of course, each to their own, and if you need to take a break from the sun for a bit so you won't overheat, there are also many ways to celebrate indoors! 🥳

🕹️Once again, Acram Digital is hosting Polish Constitution Days on Steam to celebrate the rapidly growing Polish gamedev. There are many titles to choose from, and we're proud that Lumberhill is among them! Play it from April 26th to May 3rd to celebrate the creativity of Polish game creators and check out other games to witness our creativity in its full extent! 🇵🇱

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894005/7ce093ec8cca136653564d372c8e7eaec2539b57.jpg

Can you believe it? Lumberhill is coming out next week! We’ve already got our axes well sharpened and we’ve ironed our flannel shirts so much, they’re starting to wear through. We thought we’d take this calm before the chaotic storm of chopping that’s to come to give you some more details on the different game modes that Lumberhill has to offer as there are quite a few! 

Co-op Mode

Up to four players can play in Lumberhill whether those four people are all sitting in the same room, are friends spread across the globe, or potential friends-to-be (AKA strangers) on the internet. So in other words, you can play Lumberhill locally or online. If you’re playing online, you can host a private game and invite your friends to play or you can host a public game that anyone can join (or join one yourself!).

https://i.imgur.com/M4MtKvL.gif

PvP Mode

When you’ve had enough of your friend’s excuses as to why they keep delivering BIRCH logs instead of OAK logs to the sawmill and you keep only getting one star, try out PvP mode! In PvP mode, half of your team will take nature’s side and transform into a variety of wild animals while the other half will play as lumberjacks but basically in hardmode (as now you’re being specifically targeted). Playing on nature’s side, all you have to do is keep your lumberjack friends from completing even a single task before time runs out to win. You may find that chasing your friends off of cliffs is your favorite part of the game! PvP mode can be played locally or online in private and public games.

https://i.imgur.com/EalMc4D.gif

Solo Mode

If you’re looking for a quiet time in the woods on your own...well Lumberhill is pretty chaotic so we can’t say how quiet it will be, but we’ve got woods! Have everything done the way you think best when you play in solo mode with no one else in your way (besides nature of course). And don’t worry about the difficulty, tasks are adjusted to the amount of players in a game so you should be able to get the job done solo with just the right amount of challenge.

https://i.imgur.com/jhzKQOX.gif
 
Which game mode sounds the most appealing to you? Are you planning on mostly playing online or locally? Let us know in the comments or on our Discord.
